notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Plane.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat.
